offering_description.value: Sells a data connectivity platform that helps brands, agencies, publishers and retailers link, match and activate their customer data for marketing and analytics. It is delivered mainly as cloud software subscriptions with usage-based fees and implementation support.

primary_products.value: data connectivity platform; identity resolution software; data clean room software; data onboarding software

primary_services.value: implementation and onboarding support; data collaboration consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: brands, advertising agencies, publishers, retailers, data providers, financial institutions

end_markets.value: advertising and marketing; retail; media and publishing; financial services; healthcare

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual platform access fees for data connectivity and identity software; transaction or usage fees: fees based on volume of records or data matched and activated; service fees: implementation, onboarding and consulting services
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: takes in customer and partner data and sells software to brands and data partners; service provider: provides onboarding and data collaboration support to enterprise clients

geography_served.value: global: US headquarters with customers and offices across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific

specialization.value: niche specialist: one core line: data connectivity and identity software for customer data
